Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the "Updated Understanding" section of its first turn. Although the WebSurfer search results clearly stated that Yi Guan's research was on **SARS** (identifying the civet link and preventing the 2003 pandemic), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the disease was "Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1)." This is a hallucination; the text explicitly mentions SARS, not Avian Influenza. Consequently, the Planner prematurely declared the task complete with the wrong disease name instead of verifying the full name of SARS or correcting the misinterpretation based on the provided evidence.
